data.useViewerFile: Use the file open in the EBSD Viewer
data.loadTooltip: Load the CrystalMap at the entered path for analysis.
data.qualityDesc: Mark pixels below the threshold as unindexed so they drop out of every downstream statistic. Reload to reset.
data.qualityFilterResult: Filtered {{total}} px ({{pct}}%) — {{byBc}} by BC, {{byBands}} by Bands. {{after}} of {{before}} pixels remain indexed. Reload the file to reset.
data.minBandContrastTooltip: Pixels with band contrast below this value are marked unindexed.
data.minBandsTooltip: Pixels with fewer detected bands than this are marked unindexed.
data.applyQualityFilterTooltip: Mark low-quality pixels as unindexed across all downstream statistics.
data.preprocNotImplemented: Preprocessing is not yet implemented on the backend. Parameters noted but not applied.
data.aztecDesc: Compare Aztec's per-pixel Phase + Euler (from the source h5oina) against the currently loaded result. Reveals phase-call disagreements and orientation drift between indexers.
data.aztecImageAlt: Aztec vs Orienta: Phase and orientation comparison
data.compareWithAztecTooltip: Confront Aztec's per-pixel phase and orientation with the loaded result.
data.misorientationNote: Note: high mean misorientation ({{mean}}°) often indicates a sample-frame convention mismatch (Aztec/HKL vs TSL), not a real orientation error.
data.loadEdsElementsTooltip: Read the EDS element list from the loaded dataset.
data.suggestFromEdsTooltip: Suggest candidate crystal phases from the EDS At.% composition.
data.qualityFilterGrainsNote: Grains made before this filter are still the old ones: reconstruct them again.

grain.fill: Fill holes and scratches in maps
grain.gbThresholdTooltip: Minimum misorientation (degrees) that defines a grain boundary.
grain.minGrainSizeTooltip: Grains with fewer measurements are treated as not indexed; narrow ones are then closed by their neighbours.
grain.minInterceptTooltip: Recorded in the Excel sheet; not applied by the grain reconstruction (as in the MATLAB script).
grain.alphaTooltip: Not-indexed areas narrower than about 2 × alpha pixels — holes, preparation scratches — become part of the surrounding grains. 0 closes nothing. MTEX default 3.1.
grain.fillTooltip: Closed pixels get an orientation from their own grain for display. That orientation is never used in any number, but the area of closed pixels does count in the cell-area sizes.
grain.reconstructGrainsTooltip: Reconstruct grains from the orientation map using the thresholds above.
grain.analyzeSizeTooltip: The statistics above are computed with every reconstruction and every change of the settings; this computes them again now.
grain.statsSettingsHelp: The MATLAB script's statistics: 'Like the MATLAB script', 'Measured pixels × step²' and the phase the script was run on (its ph). MTEX's: 'Like MTEX' and 'Cell area'.

edgeRule.matlab_script: Like the MATLAB script (2-pixel border strip)
edgeRule.mtex: Like MTEX (border or open not-indexed area)

edgeRuleTip.matlab_script: Leaves out grains with a measured pixel in the outermost two pixel rows or columns of the measured area; if fewer than 50 grains or less than 15 % of the grains would remain, all grains are kept. With a chosen phase, the border strip is drawn around that phase's own extent, so grains of a minority phase next to other phases are left out as well.
edgeRuleTip.mtex: Leaves out grains that touch the map border or a not-indexed area open to the border, as MTEX's isBoundary; if fewer than 50 grains or less than 15 % of the grains would remain, all grains are kept.
edgeRuleTip.outer_row: Leaves out grains with a pixel in the first or last row or column; all grains are kept if more than 85 % would be left out (Orienta's earlier rule).
edgeRuleTip.keep_all: No grain is left out; every grain enters the statistics.

ecdBasis.measured_pixels: Measured pixels × step² (like the MATLAB script)

ecdBasisTip.cell_area: ECD from the area of the grain's measurement cells, closed holes included.
ecdBasisTip.measured_pixels: ECD from the number of measured pixels times the step size squared; closed holes do not count.

grain.statEdgeSafeguardLine: Edge grains ({{rule}}): none left out (the rule's limit, see below)
grain.statEdgeSafeguardFew: All {{total}} grains kept: the {{rule}} would leave out {{edge}} edge grains, and the {{left}} left would be fewer than 50, so the rule keeps all grains.
grain.statEdgeSafeguardFewPhase: All {{total}} grains of {{phase}} kept: the {{rule}} would leave out {{edge}} edge grains, and the {{left}} left would be fewer than 50, so the rule keeps all grains.
grain.statEdgeSafeguardShare: All {{total}} grains kept: the {{rule}} would leave out {{edge}} edge grains, and the {{left}} left would be under 15 % of {{total}}, so the rule keeps all grains.
grain.statEdgeSafeguardSharePhase: All {{total}} grains of {{phase}} kept: the {{rule}} would leave out {{edge}} edge grains, and the {{left}} left would be under 15 % of {{total}}, so the rule keeps all grains.
grain.statEdgeSafeguardMany: All {{total}} grains kept: the {{rule}} would leave out {{edge}} of {{total}} grains, more than 85 %, so it keeps all grains.
grain.statsUpdateFailed: Grain-size statistics could not be updated
grain.statsPhaseMostMeasured: Phase with the most measured pixels

statsPhaseTip.all: Statistics over the grains of all phases.
statsPhaseTip.matlab_script: Statistics over the grains of this phase only. With the MATLAB-script rule the border strip is drawn around this phase's own extent, so grains of a minority phase next to other phases also count as edge grains.
statsPhaseTip.whole_map: Statistics over the grains of this phase only. The edge rule looks at the whole map: a grain next to another phase is not an edge grain.
statsPhaseTip.keep_all: Statistics over the grains of this phase only.
statsPhaseTip.mostMeasured: In each file, the phase with the most measured pixels (ties: the lower phase number); {{sentence}}

grain.statNoGrainOfPhase: No grain of {{phase}} in this map
grain.statEdgeSafeguardManyPhase: All {{total}} grains kept: the {{rule}} would leave out {{edge}} of the {{total}} grains of {{phase}}, more than 85 %, so it keeps all grains of {{phase}}.

deformation.kamOrderTooltip: Neighbour order of the KAM (a whole number from 1 to 5): the KAM of a pixel is its mean misorientation to the neighbours up to this many pixel steps away.
deformation.kamThresholdTooltip: Maximum misorientation (degrees) counted toward the KAM; larger ones are left out (more than 0, at most 30).
deformation.hagbThresholdTooltip: Boundaries from this misorientation (degrees) are high-angle boundaries (HAGB); boundaries from 3° up to it are low-angle (SAGB). More than 3, at most 90.
deformation.analyzeTooltip: Compute KAM, grain-boundary classification and sphericity.
deformation.gmmDesc: Fits three Gaussians: Deformed / Recovered / Recrystallized
deformation.fitGmmTooltip: Fit a 3-Gaussian mixture model to the BC histogram (Deformed/Recovered/RX).
deformation.notApplied: Not applied to this map yet — press Analyze Deformation
deformation.invalidParams: Enter numbers inside the ranges: KAM order a whole number 1–5, KAM threshold above 0 up to 30°, HAGB limit above 3° up to 90°.
deformation.paramsUsed: Made with: KAM order {{order}}, KAM threshold {{threshold}}°, HAGB from {{hagb}}°

texture.presetFcc: FCC Rolling — Al, Cu, Ni (14 components)
texture.presetTooltip: Choose the texture-component preset (FCC or BCC rolling families).
texture.toleranceTooltip: Maximum misorientation (degrees) for a pixel to count toward a texture component (more than 0, at most 30).
texture.loadComponentsTooltip: List the texture components of the selected preset without running the ODF.
texture.analyzeTooltip: Compute the ODF, texture-component fractions, surface planes, index and entropy.
texture.phaseMostMeasured: Phase with the most indexed pixels
texture.phaseHelp: The texture is computed on this one phase. The components are cubic, so the phase must be cubic (Al, Si, ...).
texture.planeFamily: {{plane}} planes in the surface (any plane of the family, ±15°)
texture.planeScript: as the MATLAB script, one direction ({{direction}}): {{value}} %
texture.planeScriptTooltip: The MATLAB script measures one direction per pixel, so the number depends on which of the symmetric equivalents the file stores; on Aztec data {100} and {110} come out near 0 %.
texture.toleranceInvalid: Tolerance angle: more than 0° and at most 30°.
texture.notApplied: Not applied to this map yet — press Analyze Texture
texture.planeScriptNone: as the MATLAB script, one direction ({{direction}}): —

rx.gosThresholdTooltip: One of the four criteria: a grain can only count as recrystallized if its grain orientation spread is below this value (degrees).
rx.gbcFractionTooltip: A grain counts as recrystallized only if its grain-average band contrast is greater than this fraction of the largest grain-average band contrast.
rx.gkamThresholdTooltip: Maximum grain-average KAM (degrees) for a recrystallized grain.
rx.minGrainRadiusTooltip: A grain counts as recrystallized only if its equivalent radius is greater than this value (µm); grains with exactly this radius or less do not.
rx.classifyTooltip: Decide for each grain of the chosen phase, with the four criteria (GOS, gBC, gKAM, radius), whether it counts as recrystallized.
rx.legendRx: Red: recrystallized by all four criteria (GOS, gBC, gKAM, minimum radius), as in the panel and the workbook
rx.legendLowGos: Light blue: GOS below 1.5°, but not recrystallized by all four criteria
rx.legendBands: Light blue, yellow and brown are GOS bands that give context; only red is counted in the numbers.
rx.legendNoRedBc: There is no red: the RX criteria need band contrast in the map. The colours show the GOS bands only.
rx.legendNoRedFailed: There is no red: the RX analysis could not be run on this map. The colours show the GOS bands only.
rx.invalidCriteria: Enter numbers inside the ranges: GOS 0–20°, gBC 0–1, gKAM 0–10°, radius 0–100 µm.
rx.criteriaUsed: Criteria used: GOS < {{gos}}°, gBC > {{gbc}} × largest gBC, gKAM < {{gkam}}°, radius > {{radius}} µm
rx.fixedFractionsNote: High BC, low gKAM and low KAM are fixed values of the script (0.7 × largest BC, 0.55°); they do not follow these criteria.
rx.notApplied: Not applied to this map yet — press Classify
rx.phaseMostMeasured: Phase with the most indexed pixels
rx.phaseHelp: The RX analysis counts the grains of this one phase. Grains of other phases are not recrystallized and are drawn neutral on the RX map.
rx.reasonNeedsBc: needs band contrast in the map
rx.reasonNoPixels: no grain pixel in the RX phase

batch.startHint: Choose an input folder and an output file to start.
batch.browseFolderTooltip: Browse for the folder of datasets to process.
batch.browseOutputTooltip: Choose where to save the Documentation.xlsx output.
batch.processFolderTooltip: Process every dataset in the folder and write a combined Documentation.xlsx.
batch.exportDesc: Export current dataset analysis to Excel (11 sheets — Documentation.xlsx format).
batch.workbookRecords: Sheet 1 of the workbook records, for each dataset (a file in a batch), the grain reconstruction parameters (threshold, minimum pixels, minimum intercept, alpha), the edge rule, the ECD basis, the phase, the numbers of grains in total, of edge grains found and of grains used, whether the edge rule kept all grains, and, where the RX analysis ran, the RX criteria.
batch.workbookRecordsExport: Sheet 1 of the workbook records, for the dataset, the grain reconstruction parameters (threshold, minimum pixels, minimum intercept, alpha), the edge rule, the ECD basis, the phase, the numbers of grains in total, of edge grains found and of grains used, whether the edge rule kept all grains, and, where the RX analysis ran, the RX criteria.
batch.browseExportTooltip: Choose where to save the exported .xlsx file.
batch.downloadExcelTooltip: Export the current dataset's analysis to an 11-sheet Documentation.xlsx.

batch.reconLineNoIntercept: Grain reconstruction as set in Grain Analysis: {{threshold}}°, {{minPixels}} px, alpha {{alpha}}, fill {{fill}}; min intercept not given

batch.statsSettingsOwn: The batch's own settings: they start as on the Grain Analysis tab (a single phase there becomes All phases here) and stay when you switch tabs.

batch.rxInvalid: The RX criteria in Recrystallization are incomplete or out of range; correct them there first.
batch.rxLinePending: RX criteria as set in Recrystallization (typed, not yet applied to the open map): GOS < {{gos}}°, gBC > {{gbc}} × largest gBC, gKAM < {{gkam}}°, radius > {{radius}} µm

batch.ranWithRxPending: RX: GOS < {{gos}}°, gBC > {{gbc}}, gKAM < {{gkam}}°, radius > {{radius}} µm (typed, not yet applied to the open map)
